descriptor: An AI-powered tool for luxury retail client advisors to manage client relationships by identifying clienteling opportunities, recommending products, and generating personalized messages.

requirements.statement: The system must identify the strongest clienteling opportunity from a given client profile, purchase history, preferences, and product catalog.
The system must explain the reasoning behind each clienteling opportunity recommendation.
The system must recommend an appropriate product for the identified clienteling opportunity.
The system must generate an editable personalized outreach message for the advisor.
The system must allow advisors to review and edit AI-generated messages before sending.
The system must use fictional/sample data for client profiles, preferences, purchase history, product catalog, and availability.
The system must protect client privacy by not using real customer information.
The system must persistently store information that must survive a session.
The system must follow least-privilege principles for tools and permissions.
The system must clearly distinguish facts from AI-generated recommendations.
The system must provide a user interface for luxury retail sales advisors.
The system must be designed to scale for future expansion.
The system must use AI for semantic understanding, ranking, recommendation, or generation where needed.
The system must provide a component list, data model, and data flow analysis before implementation.
The system must include security and privacy considerations in its architecture.
The system must queue drafts for human approval and never auto-send messages.
The system must use realistic fictional sample data for 10 clients, including preferences, purchase history, and product catalog.
The system must provide a recommended build order and risk assessment before implementation.

stories.title: Identify Clienteling Opportunity
stories.narrative: As a luxury retail advisor, I want to identify the strongest clienteling opportunity, so that I can prioritize my client interactions effectively.
acceptance: Given a client profile, purchase history, and preferences, When the system analyzes the data, Then it identifies the strongest clienteling opportunity.
Given incomplete client data, When the system attempts analysis, Then it provides a meaningful error message.
Trust: The system logs the reasoning for each opportunity identified.
stories.task_guidance: Implement the opportunity detection algorithm using the fictional dataset.

stories.title: Generate Personalized Outreach Message
stories.narrative: As a luxury retail advisor, I want to receive a personalized outreach message, so that I can communicate effectively with my clients.
acceptance: Given an identified opportunity, When the system generates a message, Then the message is personalized and editable.
Given an invalid opportunity, When the system attempts to generate a message, Then it provides a meaningful error message.
Trust: The system logs all generated messages for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Develop the message generation component ensuring messages are editable.

stories.title: Recommend Product for Opportunity
stories.narrative: As a luxury retail advisor, I want to receive a product recommendation, so that I can suggest relevant products to my clients.
acceptance: Given an identified opportunity, When the system recommends a product, Then the product is relevant to the client's preferences.
Given no available products, When the system attempts to recommend, Then it provides a meaningful error message.
Trust: The system logs the reasoning for each product recommendation.
stories.task_guidance: Implement product recommendation logic using the fictional product catalog.

stories.title: Develop User Interface for Advisors
stories.narrative: As a luxury retail advisor, I want a user-friendly interface, so that I can easily interact with the system.
acceptance: Given the system is running, When an advisor logs in, Then they see a user-friendly interface.
Given a UI component fails to load, When an advisor accesses the system, Then a fallback UI is displayed.
Trust: The system logs all advisor interactions with the UI.
stories.task_guidance: Design and implement the advisor dashboard with clear navigation and editing capabilities.

stories.title: Implement Data Persistence
stories.narrative: As a luxury retail advisor, I want my session data to persist, so that I can resume my work without losing information.
acceptance: Given session data, When the system saves it, Then it persists across sessions.
Given a data persistence failure, When the system attempts to save, Then it provides a meaningful error message.
Trust: The system logs all data persistence actions.
stories.task_guidance: Set up a database to store session data and ensure data integrity.

stories.title: Implement Privacy Protection Measures
stories.narrative: As a luxury retail advisor, I want to ensure client data privacy, so that I comply with privacy regulations.
acceptance: Given client data, When the system processes it, Then it uses fictional/sample data only.
Given a privacy breach attempt, When the system detects it, Then it logs and alerts the security team.
Trust: The system logs all access to client data for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement data anonymization and access controls to protect client data.

stories.title: Implement Least-Privilege Access Control
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to enforce least-privilege access, so that I minimize security risks.
acceptance: Given user roles, When the system assigns permissions, Then each user has only necessary access.
Given an access control misconfiguration, When the system detects it, Then it logs and alerts the admin.
Trust: The system logs all access control changes for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Configure role-based access controls and audit logging for all system components.

stories.title: Enhance AI Recommendation Capabilities with Fact Distinction
stories.narrative: As a user, I want AI recommendations to be clearly distinguished from factual data, so that I can make informed decisions.
acceptance: Given an AI-generated recommendation, When it is displayed, Then it is clearly marked as AI-generated
Given factual data, When it is displayed, Then it is not marked as AI-generated
Trust: Given any recommendation, When it is displayed, Then an audit log records its source as AI-generated or factual
failure_paths: Factual data is incorrectly marked as AI-generated
Audit log fails to record the source of recommendations
stories.task_guidance: Implement UI changes to label AI-generated recommendations distinctly. Update the audit log to record the source of each recommendation.

stories.title: Prepare System for Scalability
stories.narrative: As a system architect, I want the system to be scalable, so that it can handle future growth.
acceptance: Given increased load, When the system scales, Then it maintains performance and reliability.
Given a scalability issue, When the system detects it, Then it logs and alerts the admin.
Trust: The system logs all scalability-related changes for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Design system architecture to support horizontal scaling and load balancing.

stories.title: Finalize Project Planning and Risk Assessment
stories.narrative: As a project manager, I want a comprehensive project plan, so that I can ensure successful implementation.
acceptance: Given project components, When the system analyzes them, Then it provides a detailed project plan.
Given a risk assessment failure, When the system detects it, Then it provides a meaningful error message.
Trust: The system logs all project planning activities for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Compile a detailed project plan including risk assessment and recommended build order.

stories.title: Queue Drafts for Human Approval
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want all drafts to be queued for human approval, so that no message is auto-sent without review.
acceptance: Given a draft message, When it is created, Then it is added to the approval queue
Given a draft message, When it is in the queue, Then it is not auto-sent
Trust: Given a draft message, When it is approved or rejected, Then an audit log records the decision and the approver
failure_paths: Drafts are lost in the queue
Audit log fails to record approval actions
stories.task_guidance: Develop a queue system for draft messages. Implement an approval interface for human reviewers. Ensure audit logs capture approval decisions.
